[P2] Document the evidence for the selected action SHAs

Rule 6, **Mark unverified assumptions**, requires evidence for external behavior the change depends on, or an explicit `unverified` designation. These replacements assume each SHA identifies the official release named in its comment, but the PR description supplies neither verification evidence nor an unverified designation. The version comments alone do not establish that correspondence, which determines the code executed by build and release workflows. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and document the upstream release/tag evidence supporting the pins or explicitly identify unresolved assumptions.
